items.title: Analyst Relations
items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy. - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. ABOUT THE ROLE We're hiring an analyst relations manager for ElevenAgents in North America. We're looking for someone who has built an AR function from the ground up and knows what that program looks like once it's actually working – not just briefings on a calendar, but a real point of view that analysts trust and come back to. Part of that point of view is getting analysts ahead of where ElevenAgents is taking the market – an enterprise-grade platform for deploying voice and chat agents at scale. We already have a relationship with Gartner – the next phase is turning that into our first Magic Quadrant inclusion, and building that same muscle with Forrester and IDC as we expand coverage in 2027. You'll work directly with our Growth, Research and Field Deployment Engineering teams to understand what we're actually building, and turn that into a narrative analysts can act on. REQUIREMENTS - Experience running or building an analyst relations function, ideally in enterprise software, AI, or CX/contact center technology. - Direct, hands-on experience taking a company through a Gartner Magic Quadrant or Forrester Wave. You know what the submission process actually demands and you're ready to bring that same rigor to ElevenLabs. - Able to shape category narrative for a company that spans multiple product lines - helping analysts see how ElevenAgent – and eventually ElevenCreative, and ElevenAPI – add up to one coherent market position. - Comfortable prepping executives and technical leads for analyst inquiries and briefings, and building the cadence – newsletters, check-ins, event presence like Gartner IT Symposium – that keeps analysts current between them. - Bonus: experience covering agentic AI, voice AI, or conversational AI categories specifically. GROWTH POTENTIAL We believe in hiring the best talent in the world to make an impact in the right role at the right time. At ElevenLabs, strong performance creates opportunities for growth. Here are some of the career paths you can expect after excelling in this role: - Expand ownership from North America to a global analyst relations remit as we grow Forrester and IDC coverage in 2027. - Grow into a broader analyst and industry relations leadership role spanning ElevenAgents, ElevenCreative, and ElevenAPI as the function scales. LOCATION This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in North America with the ability to operate in PT or ET timezones. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in New York or San Francisco. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

items.description: BUILDING THE FUTURE OF OPEN FINANCE Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system. Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page https://www.kraken.com/culture to understand what drives us and how we work. THE TEAM Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients. The Growth Foundations team is a new, dedicated team within Growth focused on establishing foundational frontend infrastructure, best practices, and component systems that serve Kraken's entire .com platform. We are building the standards and tools that enable all frontend development across the organization to move faster, maintain higher quality, and align with modern development practices. The team collaborates closely with Engineering, Product, Marketing, and Design to create a robust component library and establish best practices that set the gold standard for frontend development at Kraken. Our mission is to empower teams across the organization with well-architected, reusable components and clear guidelines that accelerate development while ensuring consistency, quality, and maintainability across all Kraken customer-facing experiences. THE OPPORTUNITY - Design, build, and ship a comprehensive component library and design system using React.js and our custom-built CMS that serves as the foundation for all .com experiences - Build and document reusable, accessible components and integrate with our custom CMS to enable dynamic content management and component configuration across the platform - Deliver polished, pixel-perfect UI implementations that faithfully translate designs into production, working closely with Design to get every detail right - Move quickly across multiple projects and initiatives, balancing speed of delivery with quality - Establish and evolve frontend best practices, coding standards, and architectural patterns that become the model for development across the organization - Create comprehensive component documentation and guidelines that empower developers across teams to build consistently and efficiently - Set the standard for high-quality code, mentor junior and senior engineers, and significantly influence technical decisions and strategy discussions - Design and implement scalable, well-documented systems that support growth and complexity across multiple teams and initiatives - Optimize component performance, accessibility, and developer experience to accelerate team velocity and reduce friction in the development workflow - Drive process improvements and lead by example, establishing patterns and practices that become foundational to frontend development at Kraken WHAT YOU BRING - A keen eye for design and a passion for pixel-perfect implementation - A strong understanding of component-driven design and reusable architecture patterns - Experience building and maintaining design systems or component libraries at scale - A track record of thriving in fast-paced environments and delivering projects quickly - A passion for establishing best practices and improving developer experience across teams - Strong communication skills to collaborate with designers, product managers, and engineers across the organization SKILLS YOU SHOULD HODL - Proficiency with frontend testing frameworks and component testing best practices - Experience working with or integrating a CMS (custom-built or headless) - Strong understanding of web accessibility (WCAG) and UI/UX best practices - Experience within a large technology organization or fast-growing startup - Strong written and verbal communication skills in English NICE TO HAVES - Knowledge of the cryptocurrency industry and blockchain technology - items.title: Product & Technology Communications Manager
items.location_text: San Francisco, London, New York, Berlin, Toronto
items.description: Who are we? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! Why this role? Cohere has a strong AI narrative, the most deployable product, and a CEO who co-authored the foundational paper of modern AI. The company is positioned to become the transatlantic leader in sovereign AI for enterprise and government, and needs a storytelling engine to deliver that story at scale. This role sits within the team that is building that engine. This is an opportunity to define the narratives that influence how enterprises, developers, and the broader ecosystem understand the future of AI and Cohere’s role in building it. In this cross‑functional, individual‑contributor role, you’ll partner deeply with product, research, engineering, and go‑to‑market teams to translate complex technical work into clear, compelling stories. You’ll help Cohere articulate what we’re building, why it matters, and how our technology is reshaping enterprise AI. You’ll craft narratives that resonate with technical and non‑technical audiences alike, and build programs that elevate Cohere’s product leadership and technical credibility. This is a rare opportunity to build a product and technology communications function at a fast-growing company in the most dynamic space in technology. This is a role for someone who takes great joy at distilling technically complex ideas into mainstream messages that can be understood by all media globally. As Product & Technology Communications Manager, you will: - Develop product and technology communications strategies that support Cohere’s business goals, product roadmap, and technical differentiation - Partner with product, engineering, research, and modeling leaders to craft messaging, narratives, and materials that explain Cohere’s technology in accessible, high-impact ways - Lead communications around product launches, including messaging frameworks, FAQs, press releases, and executive talking points - Translate complex technical concepts into clear, compelling content for customers, partners, analysts, and media - Collaborate with corporate comms to drive proactive storytelling that elevates Cohere’s technical leadership and product momentum - Work closely with marketing to ensure consistency across product marketing, developer content, and external communications - Support thought leadership for product, research, and modeling executives - Use qualitative and quantitative insights to refine messaging and understand what resonates with technical audiences - Prepare and support crisis and issues communications related to product, security, or technical incidents, partnering with Corporate Communications and relevant teams You may be a good fit if you: - Have 5–7 years of experience in product and technology communications, or technical content — ideally in AI, enterprise software, or developer‑focused environments - Are an exceptional writer with a talent for simplifying complex technical topics without losing nuance - Have experience partnering with product and engineering leaders and can operate as a trusted advisor - Understand enterprise AI, machine learning, or developer ecosystems and are eager to go deeper - Are highly organized and detail‑oriented with strong project management skills and a bias for action - Are comfortable navigating ambiguity and thrive in fast‑moving, high‑growth environments - Have experience with product launches, technical content development, or developer‑focused communications - Build strong cross‑functional relationships to drive clarity, consistency, and alignment across teams FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS: - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch. - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health. - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme. - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent. - Annual enrichment benefits: Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit. Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching. - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!) - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite. HOW AND WHERE WE WORK: - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon. - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events. - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city. - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly. If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12a6IrLdF3kI2nonKSr4tiFuz18rLQbaeYV-JM9L4o9Q/edit, and we will work together to meet your needs. We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider. Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers https://cohere.com/careers page.

The Wow You will own the product backlog , definition of requirements and day-to-day product delivery for an assigned brand /s , working closely with internal stakeholders and 3rd party platform partners. The role combines product ownership, delivery management and supplier management , requiring someone who can work independently, make sound decisions and take initiatives from idea through to production. A taster of what you will be involved with: Own and prioritise the product backlog , balancing business value, customer impact, complexity, effort and product strategy. Define and refine product requirements , working with stakeholders to understand business needs and translate them into clear, actionable requirements for the 3rd party platform. Bring a commercial mindset to product decisions , understanding the impact on customers and the business and challenging ideas where appropriate. Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders and external platform partners , maintaining clear communication, alignment and accountability. Own delivery with the 3rd party platform , agreeing timelines, tracking progress and proactively managing risks, dependencies and blockers. Hold the 3rd party platform accountable for delivery commitment and quality , constructively challenging proposed solutions, managing underperformance and escalating through established governance processes where necessary. Coordinate release readiness with Product, QA and relevant stakeholders, ensuring deliverables are ready for UAT and production. Proactively identify opportunities to improve the product and customer experience , using data, customer behaviour, feedback and business insights to investigate problems, propose solutions and drive improvements through to delivery. What we are looking for At least 5 years of experience in Product Management, Product Ownership, Product Delivery, Project Management or a similar role . Commercially minded , with an understanding of how product decisions impact customers and the wider business. Comfortable owning and prioritising a product backlog , making day-to-day product decisions independently while aligning with business objectives and stakeholder priorities. Strong stakeholder management, communication and ownership skills , with the ability to drive initiatives through to completion. Pragmatic and solution-oriented , able to balance business needs, customer experience, technical constraints and 3rd party platform capabilities. Good analytical and problem-solving skills , with the ability to use data and customer insights to support decisions. You will be expected to make use of analytical tools such as Google Analytics and FullStory amongst others to understand customer problems and bring forward solutions. Good technical understanding , with the ability to understand platform capabilities, integrations, dependencies and technical constraints. Assertive and resilient in supplier management , able to maintain constructive relationships while holding 3rd party partners to agreed commitments, creating urgency and escalating decisively when delivery or quality falls short. A strong agile mindset , proactive attitude and confidence to challenge and find practical solutions. Excellent written and verbal English communication skills . Lithuanian is a strong advantage. What would be an advantage Experience in the iGaming industry . Experience working with 3rd party PAM, sportsbook, other gaming technology platforms . Experience managing external technology suppliers or platform partners. Experience working with analytics tools What we offer Much like riding a rollercoaster, sometimes life at Betsson can be lightning fast with twists and turns but always FUN! Then again, what else would you expect from a business 75% millennial and 1700 strong, spread across 7 offices with 900 based out of our Malta HQ alone! We recognise it may not be for the faint-hearted, but if you’re a go-getter, initiator and adrenaline junkie, always striving to push the boundaries and challenge yourself, then you’ll fit right in. Challenge accepted? By submitting your application, you understand that your personal data will be processed as set out in our Privacy Policy

items.title: Junior QA Engineer
items.description: About us: EveryMatrix is a leading B2B SaaS provider delivering iGaming software, content and services. We provide casino, sports betting, platform and payments, and affiliate management to 200 customers worldwide. But that's not all! We're not just about numbers, we're about people. With a team of over 1000 passionate individuals spread across twelve countries in Europe, Asia, and the US, we're all united by our love for innovation and teamwork. EveryMatrix is a member of the World Lottery Association (WLA) and European Lotteries Association . In September 2023 it became the first iGaming supplier to receive WLA Safer Gambling Certification . EveryMatrix is proud of its commitment to safer gambling and player protection whilst producing market leading gaming solutions. Join us on this exciting journey as we continue to redefine the iGaming landscape, one groundbreaking solution at a time. We are looking for a passionate and dedicated Junior QA Engineer to join our team in Lviv! What You'll get to do: Design, maintain, and execute test cases for APIs, web, and mobile applications. Perform functional, regression, and integration testing across services and applications. Work with API testing tools (Postman, REST Assured, or similar) to validate endpoints, requests, and responses. Apply basic OOP concepts when writing or maintaining automated tests. Execute manual testing for web and mobile apps (UI/UX, cross-browser, cross-platform). Participate in bug reporting, verification, and tracking in tools like Jira or Azure DevOps. Collaborate closely with developers to clarify requirements and reproduce issues. Support the QA team in building automation coverage and integrating tests into CI/CD pipelines. Contribute to QA documentation: test plans, test reports, and checklists. What You need to know: 1 + years of QA experience. Practical experience with API testing. Knowledge of HTTP, JSON, XML, and authentication methods (OAuth, JWT, API keys). Hands-on experience in web testing (desktop & responsive) and mobile app testing (iOS/Android). Familiarity with at least one programming or scripting language. Understanding of basic OOP principles (inheritance, encapsulation, abstraction, polymorphism). Experience with bug tracking and test management tools (Jira, TestRail). Good communication skills and ability to work in a cross-functional team. Here's what we offer: Start with 22 days of annual leave, with 2 additional days added each year, up to 32 days by your fifth year with us. 3 sick leave days per year, no doctor's note required; 30 medical leave days with medical allowance Hybrid work schedule is available after the first three months of employment with 80/20 office/home format until the end of 2026. Starting from 2027, the policy will transition to primarily office-based work, with up to 10 work-from-home days per year with manager approval. Benefit from two Free Fridays each year, limited to one per quarter. Daily catered lunch or monthly lunch allowance. Private Medical Subscription. Access online learning platforms like Udemy for Business, LinkedIn Learning or O’Reilly, and a budget for external training. Gym allowance. Corporate English lessons. Support for New Parents: 21 weeks of paid maternity leave, with the flexibility to work from home full-time until your child turns 1 year old. 4 weeks of paternity leave, plus the flexibility to work from home full-time until your child is 13 weeks old. Our office perks include on-site massages and frequent team-building activities in various locations. At EveryMatrix, we're committed to creating a supportive and inclusive workplace where you can thrive both personally and professionally. Come join us and experience the difference!

items.title: IT Engineer
items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy. - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. ABOUT THE ROLE This is a hands-on technical role. You will join during a period of high growth for the IT team as the company expands its headcount, global footprint and opens new offices. You will work closely with the Security and Operations teams to keep our endpoints, offices, networks, and SaaS tools secure, while making sure people stay as productive as possible with the tools we have. You'll own and deliver technical projects across identity, endpoint management, office infrastructure, automation, and compliance, helping us build scalable IT systems that support the company as it grows. REQUIREMENTS - Strong hands-on background in IT Engineering, Technical Operations, or a DevOps-adjacent role, with an automation-first mindset and experience managing enterprise scale IT systems - Strong knowledge of identity and access management technologies (SAML, SCIM, OIDC) with tools such as Okta and Google Workspace - Expertise with Mobile Device Management tooling (e.g. Jamf, Kandji, Fleet) across a device fleet. - Scripting skills (Python, Bash, or similar) with a proven track record of automating compliance checks, device configuration, and other IT security tasks. - Experience managing office network equipment (e.g. Cisco Meraki, Ubiquiti), including office buildouts. - Proven ability to maintain compliance with SOC 2 / ISO 27001 (or similar) standards, paired with a friendly, end-user-focused attitude. - Prior experience in a high-growth or startup environment. BONUS - Experience implement corporate security controls / previous security role experience - Strong hands-on experience with VPNs, firewalls, and secure network environments, including modern practices such as Zero Trust networking. - Experience with OSquery and Santa - Terraform or other infrastructure as code experience. - Open source contributions (e.g. a tool you built to automate something). LOCATION This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in Singapore or Sydney. #LI-Remote We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

items.title: Head of Risk
items.location_text: Europe, Serbia, Poland, Georgia, Remote - Slovakia, Remote — Romania, Lithuania, Latvia, Ukraine, Estonia, Limassol, Slovenia
items.description: REMOTE | EUROPE (CET/EET ±2H) | B2B CONTRACT | REPORTS TO THE CEO About the company Our client is an established, profitable fintech operating at the intersection of crypto and traditional payments. It runs a consumer on/off-ramp platform and a fast-growing B2B infrastructure business: APIs and white-label solutions that let exchanges, neobanks, PSPs, wallets and other platforms embed regulated crypto and fiat services. The company is authorised under MiCA and PSD2 in the EU and is actively expanding its licence footprint, including e-money authorisations in Europe and the UK. The culture is owner-led, high-ownership and low-bureaucracy: decisions are made quickly and close to the founders. About the role This is a senior, hands-on leadership role. You will be the company’s Head of Risk, a member of the leadership team reporting directly to the CEO. The function starts as a one-person department and may grow as it matures. A foundation already exists: a risk register, risk appetite statement, DORA vendor risk work, and governance drafts. Your mission is to turn it into a proactive, decision-oriented risk function. That means bringing risk to leadership before it becomes a problem, and being a fast, credible partner to the commercial and product teams rather than a bottleneck. What you will own - Enterprise risk framework: risk taxonomy, risk appetite and tolerances, risk register, escalation policy and the three-lines-of-defence model. - Risk reporting: regular risk dashboards for the CEO and leadership, board/committee reporting, and risk-related regulatory reporting. - DORA: ICT risk management, incident classification and reporting, third-party ICT risk and the Register of Information, with a hard regulatory deadline ahead. - Licensing: operational risk, capital adequacy, liquidity and safeguarding frameworks for new e-money authorisations in parallel jurisdictions. - B2B partner and counterparty risk: onboarding risk scoring, risk-tiered monitoring, risk sign-off on material partnerships, and concentration risk. - Financial and market risk, jointly with Finance: crypto price exposure, settlement and liquidity risk, counterparty exposure to liquidity providers and banking partners, and capital adequacy monitoring. - Operational resilience: business continuity, disaster recovery, vendor risk and major incident reporting. - Fraud risk appetite: acceptable loss rates by channel, product and geography, unified across the teams that currently share it. - Product risk: risk assessment and launch gating for new products and markets, involved early rather than at the finish line. - Risk governance and culture: running the risk committee and building risk ownership across business units. What we are looking for - 8-10+ years in financial services or fintech risk, including at least 3–4 years at a senior risk leadership level (Head of Risk, VP Risk, or equivalent). A CRO title is not required, but ownership at that level is. - Direct experience in a regulated fintech, payment institution, EMI, PSP, or crypto business. Comfort with pace and lean structures is essential. - Hands-on experience with at least one of: DORA ICT risk, MiCA (CASP) risk requirements, or PSD2 payment institution operational and security risk. UK FCA operational resilience experience is a strong equivalent. - A clear track record of owning risk outcomes, not only advising on them. - The ability to give a clear risk position and recommendation under incomplete information, and to hold that position under pressure from senior stakeholders. - The ability to communicate risk in business language, in terms of impact, cost and options. - Fluent professional English. Nice to have - Previous Head of Risk / CRO role at a regulated fintech, EMI, PSP or crypto company. - Experience building a risk function from scratch in a scaling business. - Experience with crypto custody risk, MiCA capital requirements, or Travel Rule implementation. - Third-party / vendor risk management at scale, especially in B2B or embedded-finance models. - Experience chairing a risk committee or reporting to a board. - FRM, PRM, or a comparable qualification. - Russian language. What’s on offer - A seat on the leadership team and direct access to the founders. - Real ownership: you shape the risk function and its role in the business. - A remote-first setup, with periodic in-person time at the European HQ. - Long-term B2B contract with performance- and OKR-linked bonus. - 20 paid working days off per year, paid sick leave, health insurance, a professional development budget, and team events.
